Hi Marissa / Karthik,

We reached final alignment with Samira at Acme Health and Evan verbally accepted pending written offer. Proposed package below (attached: comp_band_summary_Q3_2025.xlsx):

- Title: Software Engineer II (SDE2)
- Base salary: $160,000
- Target bonus: 10% (performance-based)
- Equity: 0.20% RSUs, 4-year vesting (25/25/25/25)

Subject: Re: Offer proposal: Evan Cho (SDE2) - please authorize

Thanks Naomi — quick notes/questions before I sign off: 

1) Equity: 0.20% seems slightly above the typical SDE2 target for this cost center (Q3 band doc shows 0.12–0.18%). Can we justify 0.20% based on the competing offer? If not, I prefer 0.18% and increase signing bonus slightly.
2) Bonus: 10% is fine, confirm whether that is pro-rated for the first year if start is late Aug/Sept.
3) Signing bonus: $7.5k is ok, but I want to ensure payroll can handle the one-time and it's included in the offer letter language.
4) Please include the headcount code (HC-3421) and budget owner (Samira Khan) in the offer metadata for finance.

If payroll/HR can support prorated bonus and a $1k bump to signing, I'm happy to authorize and get DocuSign ready. Karthik — any strong opinions on equity vs signing mix here?

Best,
Marissa

Thanks — quick decision here to keep the candidate warm. Approve the package with the following tweaks: 

- Base: $160,000 (no change)
- Target bonus: 10% and should be prorated for partial first year (standard practice)
- Equity: set to 0.18% (aligns with SDE2 midpoint but competitive)
- Signing bonus: $8,500 (increase by $1,000 as Marissa suggested)
- Add one-line in the offer: "Signing bonus paid following 30 days of employment; non-recoupable unless voluntary departure within 90 days."

Budget note: please charge to cost center 8302 (Platform) and include HC-3421 in the push to finance. We should also add a one-time exceptional approval flag for the signing bonus > standard cap; I will mark this in the HC ticket.

Marissa — you can mark this as authorized from my side and proceed to send. Naomi — please attach the updated offer_letter_Evan_Cho_v1.pdf and DocuSign link.
